source: ENDF/B-VIII.0 (D. A. Brown et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 148, 1 (2018)), neutron and neutron fission yield sublibraries from the NNDC archives in data/endf, parsed by libs/constants/scripts/generate-endf.ts: MF3 cross sections in barns above the resolved-resonance boundary, with the MF2 Reich–Moore resolved resonances of the actinides (Z ≥ 90) reconstructed down to 1e-5 eV and added to the MF3 background, MF4 Legendre mean cosine of elastic scattering in the centre of mass, MF1 prompt neutrons per fission, MF1/MF5 MT455 delayed neutrons per fission with the decay constants, abundances and spectra (64 quantiles) of their precursor groups, MF5 tabulated prompt fission spectra as 64 quantiles, MF8 independent fission-product yields per incident energy; energies in eV, thinned to 0.5% under linear interpolation up to 20 MeV
